The '''''Java''''' was a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==History==
The Java was one of 3 Assault transports that was sent to [[Capture of ZA-13|retake]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[ZA-13]]. The factory was originally used to manufacture [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] for [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] fighters, that could also be mounted onto [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. After [[Attack on ZA-13|driving]] of [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]], the ''Java'', which carried a boarding crew, was the first to dock with the facility and capture the factory then jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. The other assault transports [[Themor]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Shuttle]] [[Sigma]] and [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttles]] [[Omega]] would then do the same.
